lessons.correction: Increase air presence and technology while continuing to strengthen the ground army. Expand and keep production going.
lessons.mistake: Sticking purely to ground forces and production, being too passive, and neglecting to scout for tech switches like Mutalisks.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have a clear read on the Zerg's composition or if you plan to take a fourth base.
lessons.title: Late Midgame: Avoid Passive Ground Focus
lessons.when: Around 10 minutes, with a strong ground army (Siege Tanks, Marines, Medivacs, Widow Mines) and the opponent fielding heavy ground forces (Zerglings, Roaches, Queens) with heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: The opponent's heavy production demands a diversified force; adding air units and tech provides a late-game edge.

lessons.correction: Continue to increase economy and expansion while maintaining production and tech. Keep the army strong.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to a single tech path without scouting, potentially missing tech switches.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's tech or if you are ready to take a third base.
lessons.title: Early Midgame: Avoid Overcommitting Without Scouting
lessons.when: Around 5-6 minutes, with Marines and Reapers, heavy production and tech, against Zerglings and Queens with moderate production and tech.
lessons.why: Heavy tech and production provide an advantage; expanding secures the lead.

lessons.correction: Increase economy and maintain production and tech. Keep the army strong and be ready to defend.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to early pressure if the Zerg has a strong defense, delaying expansion or production.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's expansion or if you see signs of an early attack.
lessons.title: Early Game: Avoid Delaying Expansion
lessons.when: Around 3 minutes, with a Marine and heavy production, moderate economy, against Zerglings and Queens with moderate production and light tech.
lessons.why: Heavy production and tech give an advantage; maintaining economy allows outscaling the Zerg.
